_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json or other fragments
_meta.description: Tier-2 invoice generation from approved time entries and expense records (issue #111). Adds three companion schemas: BillableInvoice (the time+expense materialisation of the canonical Invoice), BillableInvoiceLine (line items with sourceType + rateApplied snapshot), and RetainerSchedule (monthly recurring fee with optional T&M overage threshold). Supports five billing models — t_and_m, fixed_fee, milestone, retainer, mixed — selectable per invoice (D1). Rates from RateCard are snapshot'd into rateApplied at generation time so historical invoices retain original rates if the rate card is later amended (D2). Retainer charges render as a mandatory separate line item per month (D3). Time entries reference the existing UrenRegistratie schema (closest equivalent to the spec's TimeEntry); expenses reference ExpenseClaimEntry. Monetary fields use multipleOf 0.01 with integer-cent persistence per the Money type used elsewhere in shillinq (e.g. VATReturn.totalVATCollected).

BillableInvoice.title: Billable Invoice
BillableInvoice.description: Invoice materialised from approved time entries + expenses with explicit billing-model semantics. Companion to the canonical Invoice (from bookings-deposit-to-invoice); the BillableInvoice carries the model-specific projection while the Invoice carries the AR-aging-facing record. The billingModel is set once at draft time and immutable after posting (REQ-ITE-001, D1). Source-id arrays (timeEntryIds, expenseIds) are checked for duplicates against existing posted/draft BillableInvoice rows before generation (REQ-ITE-006, D9).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this invoice for tenant isolation.

invoiceNumber.description: Human-readable invoice number (Dutch: factuurnummer), e.g. BIL-2026-0042.

billingModel.description: Billing-model selector (REQ-ITE-001, D1). Drives line-item composition and revenue-account choice on GL posting.

customerId.description: FK to the customer (Nextcloud contact entity).

projectId.description: FK to the Project this invoice covers (single-project per invoice in T2; multi-project deferred to T3).

timeEntryIds.description: FKs to UrenRegistratie rows included in this invoice. Stored for audit + deduplication even when the model is fixed_fee/milestone (where hours are informational only).

expenseIds.description: FKs to ExpenseClaimEntry rows included in this invoice.

rateCardId.description: FK to the RateCard applied — required for t_and_m and mixed, optional for retainer overage, null for fixed_fee/milestone (REQ-ITE-002, D2).

retainerScheduleId.description: FK to the RetainerSchedule applied — required for retainer and mixed, null for the others (REQ-ITE-005).

lineItemsByModel.description: Per-sourceType summary: {time_entry: {count, totalCents}, expense: {count, totalCents}, retainer_charge: {count, totalCents}, fixed_fee: {count, totalCents}}. Computed at draft time for fast reporting.

summary.description: Computed totals snapshot: {netAmount, vatAmount, grossAmount, currency}. Used by list views without re-totalling line items.

netAmount.description: Total excluding VAT in euros (2-decimal precision; persisted as integer cents in services).

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code. T2 supports EUR only (D2); multi-currency deferred to T4.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Moves draft → posted when postInvoice() runs; cancelled is operator-initiated and prevents GL posting.

posted.description: True once GL posting completed (status=posted + Obligation created). Read-only convenience flag mirroring status.

obligationId.description: FK to the Obligation entity created at post time. Null until posted.

notes.description: Free-text operator notes captured at draft time, included in the PDF footer.

BillableInvoiceLine.title: Billable Invoice Line
BillableInvoiceLine.description: Single line item on a BillableInvoice. sourceType identifies the originating record (time_entry, expense, retainer_charge, fixed_fee, manual). rateApplied snapshots the applicable RateCard rate so historical invoices preserve their original rates if the rate card is later amended (REQ-ITE-003, D2). modelSpecificFields carries milestone/retainer-month metadata when applicable.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration (mirror of parent invoice for tenant-scoped queries).

sourceId.description: FK to the source record (UrenRegistratie ID for time_entry, ExpenseClaimEntry ID for expense, RetainerSchedule ID for retainer_charge). Null for fixed_fee and manual.

description.description: Customer-facing line description rendered on the PDF.

billableUnits.description: Hours (for time_entry) or count (for expense / retainer_charge). Pre-multiplier figure used for the rate × units display.

rateApplied.description: Snapshot of the rate used: {rateCents (integer cents), currency, rateCardVersion, effectiveDate}. Null when the line is not rate-based (expense / fixed_fee / manual).

markup.description: Markup percentage applied to (rate × units). Per-invoice in T2; per-line markup is T3+.

costAmount.description: Final line cost in euros after rate × units × (1 + markup/100). Persisted as integer cents in services for exact arithmetic.

vatRate.description: VAT/BTW percentage for this line. Dutch invoices use 21 / 9 / 6 / 0.

vatAmount.description: VAT amount in euros (= costAmount × vatRate / 100, rounded to €0.01 with bankers' rounding).

modelSpecificFields.description: Model-specific metadata: {milestoneId, milestoneCompletedAt, milestoneName, milestoneBudget} for milestone; {retainerMonth: 'YYYY-MM'} for retainer; {} otherwise.

RetainerSchedule.title: Retainer Schedule
RetainerSchedule.description: Monthly recurring fee + optional T&M overage threshold. Referenced from BillableInvoice.retainerScheduleId when billingModel is retainer or mixed (REQ-ITE-005). monthlyAmount is locked in via effectiveDate so historical invoices retain the rate in force on their invoiceDate (D3).

customerId.description: FK to the customer this retainer applies to.

projectId.description: Optional FK if the retainer is scoped to a specific project.

label.description: Human-readable label rendered on the invoice line (e.g. 'Monthly support retainer').

overageHoursThreshold.description: Hours included in the retainer before overage T&M billing kicks in. Null disables overage detection.

overageHourlyRate.description: Hourly rate (€) charged on overage hours when overageHoursThreshold is set.

effectiveDate.description: Date this schedule version becomes the active rate. Earlier invoices see the previous schedule.

endDate.description: Optional end date for time-bounded retainers.
